# Architecture overview

The system is composed of three services that communicate over gRPC.
Each service has its own database and exposes a REST API for external
clients. The billing service handles invoices and recurring charges.
Authentication is delegated to a shared identity provider; tokens are
short-lived and rotate hourly.

## Tradeoffs

We considered a monolith but the operational independence of separate
services was worth the integration complexity. Documentation lives in
this repository alongside the code it describes.
